map.对公关传播效果进行系统化量化评估，涵盖媒体报道、传播声量、情感倾向、关键信息渗透: A systematic quantified assessment of PR communication effect covering five dimensions - media coverage, communication volume, sentiment tendency, key message penetration and crisis response - to help produce a PR effect evaluation report.
map.📖 查看「公关（效果/评估/报告）体系 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'PR (Effect/Evaluation/Reporting) System'
map.关键信息渗透率 = 包含核心传播信息的报道/总报道: Key message penetration rate = reports containing the core message / total reports
map.核心媒体指行业头部媒体和权威媒体: Core media means industry-leading media and authoritative media
map.情感倾向分析需使用舆情监测工具辅助: Sentiment tendency analysis needs the support of public opinion monitoring tools
map.关键信息渗透率=包含核心传播信息的报道/总报道: Key message penetration rate = reports containing the core message / total reports
map.效果评分13分以上为优秀，10分以上为良好: An effect score of 13 or above is excellent, and 10 or above is good
map.一场品牌战役收官后，汇总报道篇数、核心媒体数、曝光量，并对情感倾向、信息渗透、危: After a brand campaign wraps up, tally the number of reports, core media count and impressions, and score 0-5 on sentiment tendency, message penetration and crisis response to quantify the communication effect.
map.对比战役前设定的 KPI（核心媒体占比目标、曝光目标），看达成度。: Compare against the KPIs set before the campaign (core media share target, impression target) to see the attainment.
map.把多场战役的效果分做时间序列，识别「声量高但渗透低」的虚胖战役。: Plot the effect scores of multiple campaigns as a time series to identify 'high volume but low penetration' inflated campaigns.
map.展示指标：报道总篇数、核心媒体报道数、核心媒体占比 = 核心媒体数 ÷ 报道总篇: Displayed metrics: total number of reports, number of core media reports, core media share = core media count ÷ total reports × 100%, estimated impressions (10k person-times). Effect score = sentiment tendency + key message penetration + crisis response (0-5 each, 15 in total); grades: ≥13 excellent, ≥10 good, ≥7 qualified, <7 insufficient. Note: report count and impressions are only for display and do not count toward the effect total.
map.某战役：报道 50 篇、核心媒体 20 篇 → 核心占比 40%；曝光 2000: One campaign: 50 reports, 20 core media → core share 40%; impressions 20 million person-times; sentiment 5 + penetration 5 + crisis 4 = 14 points, judged excellent (≥13). By contrast, another campaign: 50 reports, 20 core (share still 40%), impressions 20 million, but sentiment 3 + penetration 3 + crisis 2 = 8 points, judged only qualified - showing that although the latter 'published a lot', positive sentiment and key message reach are weak, a typical 'high volume, low penetration' case.
map.为什么报道篇数不算进效果分？: Why is the report count not counted in the effect score?
map.篇数是「量」、情感/渗透/危机是「质」，混在一起会被刷量干扰。把篇数、曝光作为展: Count is 'quantity', while sentiment/penetration/crisis are 'quality'; mixing them lets inflation interfere. Keeping count and impressions as separate display metrics, the effect score only judges 'was it said right, did it get through, did anything go wrong', which is closer to the essence of PR - influencing awareness rather than piling up column inches.
map.核心媒体占比 40% 算高吗？: Is a 40% core media share high?
map.取决于行业与战役目标。40% 属健康区间（说明近半数报道来自权威信源，背书强）；: It depends on the industry and the campaign goal. 40% is a healthy range (meaning nearly half the reports come from authoritative sources, giving strong endorsement); below 20% is mostly long-tail self-published media, whose credibility and secondary spread are markedly reduced. This tool only gives the share figure; the target value must be set against your own media matrix.
